name: 前端工程师 · 页面实现

steps.instruction:
【Agent】global://frontend-engineer（~/.claude/agents/frontend-engineer.md）
【输入】`docs/prd.md`、`docs/architecture-note.md`、`docs/ui-spec.md`（若有）
【交付】按对话中已确认的范围、验收标准与工作区相关文档执行。

【任务】实现可运行页面；说明写入默认 md，代码写入 src/

【READ】Read upstream artifacts first (pre-injected if exist): `docs/prd.md`, `docs/architecture-note.md`, `docs/ui-spec.md`, `docs/ux-architecture.md`.
【WARN】If a file path doesn't exist, do NOT read/fake it. Work with what's available or ask.

【PATH】`docs/frontend-implementation.md`
【WRITE】Use `workspace-write` fences or code blocks with file paths to write. System auto-saves your reply.

【1】Base on pre-injected state. No fake docs. Never read/fake non-existent files.
【2】Your reply IS the artifact. Produce structured Chinese markdown.
